study.question: Does the compact scalar evidence benefit require target-matched action statistics or actual event-age values, rather than general action composition and cell presence?
study.hypothesis: Observed trajectories: static/pooled/attention validation AUCs are 0.605004/0.610226/0.613362. The matched wider redundancy control is 0.612923; count-only 0.618068, freshness-only 0.615610, and count+freshness 0.618664. Adding freshness to counts gives only +0.00059588 AUC and worsens Logloss by 0.00001463; factorial AUC interaction is -0.00209204. Thus the earlier positive freshness-only effect does not establish independent timing value. Inherited freshness equals zero for empty group-action cells and can reveal occupancy. Hypothesis: much of the count gain is target-conditioned action evidence, while some of the freshness gain is easier access to occupancy. Replacing conditional freshness with presence may preserve ranking quality. This is a provisional explanation, not established mechanism support. No failed trials are reported in the accessible trajectory; the redundant-width branch underperforms baseline attention and the combined branch has adverse Logloss relative to count-only. These negative results are retained.

nearest_work.difference: Original DIN makes the user representation target-dependent and explicitly abandons softmax to preserve intensity. We inherit the local field-adapted normalized attention and test deterministic action-by-target-match evidence replacement. Neither target conditioning nor preserving intensity is claimed novel; no exact DIN reproduction or priority claim is made.

The parent directly exposes 16 counts and 16 conditional freshness values. This study adds explicit occupancy substitution and target-group-to-global substitution with a same-round anchor, without adding representation width.

inherited_components: All parent embeddings, module construction order, normalized target attention, recency bucket construction and MLP.
All/category/brand/joint groups crossed with pv/cart/fav/buy; nonzero target match guards; masked causal last-128-event reductions.
Counts log(1+n)/log(129); conditional freshness sum(exp(-age/86400))/max(n,1); no lifetime count interpretation.
Host optimization, data passes, scorer, split, checkpointing and resource accounting; no optimizer/loss changes.
study.proposed_difference: A two-factor deterministic evidence replacement. The temporal factor chooses conditional freshness T or presence P=1[n>0]. The target factor chooses the original all/category/brand/joint cells or repeats the all-history four-action cells four times. The attention summary is always retained. Thus activity cells expose only eight unique scalar values (four counts plus four time/presence entries) through the same 32 scalar columns; presence cells contain no additional event-age values in their direct scalar readout. This is information simplification with matched nominal capacity and core arithmetic, not a measured parameter/latency compression result. Actual narrower heads or attention removal require later capacity and cost controls. Novelty is unverified.
predictions: The same-round target_time anchor should reproduce the incumbent within 0.0001 AUC and have 17134371 parameters under the frozen host meta.
Target-group readouts should improve AUC relative to global activity repetitions at both temporal settings; a practical screening threshold of 0.0003 AUC is predeclared, not a significance threshold.
Presence may preserve target_time AUC within 0.0003 while improving or retaining Logloss; a single close result only nominates a simplification for paired follow-up.
Conditional age-value increment may be larger for target groups than for global activity; estimate both simple effects and their interaction rather than declaring independent additive benefits.

Existing history-length and category-match slices are exploratory localization checks; short-history and empty-history effects may differ from the dominant >64-event slice. Report sample/positive/negative counts supplied by the host.
falsifiers: A target_time advantage over target_presence exceeding 0.0003 AUC contradicts the practical presence-sufficiency prediction and warrants paired repeats; improved Logloss strengthens its relevance.
AUC equality or superiority of activity replacements at both time settings contradicts a consequential direct target-match increment in this architecture.
If target_presence loses materially while activity_presence does not, the explanation must include target/time interaction rather than occupancy alone.
Anchor drift exceeding 0.0001 AUC, differing parameter counts, invalid masked or missing-field handling, or any change to host contracts invalidates small-effect attribution until resolved.
Any claim of computational compression is falsified as a present deliverable: all cells deliberately retain head width and compute the full evidence for attribution.
alternative_explanations: Repeated global features preserve nominal parameter count but reduce unique information and change effective optimization geometry.
Presence is already a deterministic function of counts; exposing it changes accessibility and feature scale. Time-versus-presence is a readout replacement, not proof that time is absent elsewhere.
The unchanged learned attention summary already uses target identity, action and time; all effects are incremental to that summary.
Training couples all examples: empty-history slice changes can arise indirectly, even though both scalar blocks are zero for those examples.
One seed is preliminary; correlated user exposures and validation selection prevent single-run significance claims.
Exposure selection, static snapshot as-of uncertainty and history truncation can limit external validity.
Bucket equality can include hash collisions and is not verified original-identity equality.
The prior first-512 candidate diagnostics are descriptive, nonrepresentative and label-free; no decay constants or thresholds are fitted to them.
Known unnormalized DIN or alternative input scaling may explain benefits without a new mechanism.
No missing-field or unseen-field slice is invented; only host-provided slices and scalar diagnostics are available in this phase.

cost_plan.stop_rule: Never raise the host trial cap or resource limit. Before each host submission check that full capped cells and reserves fit the live ledger; omit optional cells or stop if not.
